captions.detailed: A classic reel-style slot machine cabinet featuring a curved dome top box and a central glass-covered window showing three spinning reels. Below the screen is a projecting horizontal control shelf in black with five colorful, circular push buttons (red, yellow, green, blue, orange). The lower portion features a recessed service door with a small handle. The cabinet is styled in a deep red and black color scheme with a tan-bordered screen frame and a yellow marquee display at the top.
captions.instruction: Create a 3D model of a tall reel-style slot machine cabinet. The assembly should feature a curved top-box marquee, a central framed window displaying three independent cylindrical slot reels, a protruding front button shelf with five individual prismatic push buttons in different colors, and a lower recessed service door configured to rotate on a side hinge.
captions.factory: Construct the main cabinet body using a combination of boxes and a filleted top curve. Model the screen window and the lower service door as separate recessed panels, adding a revolute articulation joint to the door. Create the three reels as cylinders rotated horizontally and placed behind a transparent glass pane. Build the front button shelf as a protruding block, and construct five small cylinders for the buttons, attaching each with a prismatic joint to allow independent vertical pressing motion.
